title: Pais stops Jesse's questions in motel interview
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Pais stops Jesse's questions in motel interview, about 2020s at motel near Pax River, Maryland, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: got to a certain level of the science where he freaked out and he goes, "Jesse, stop right there. Like, just stop asking.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says he once interviewed a scientist named Salvatore Pais in a motel near Pax River, a Navy base in Maryland, sometime in the 2020s. According to Michels, when the talk reached a certain level of the science, Pais got alarmed and told him, "Jesse, stop right there. Just stop asking." Michels tells it as a sign that there was something Pais felt he could not talk about.
